audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 4 were given to Teemo while their own why-strings are Kled-positive ('W comes online and lets you out-trade', 'at 3 you have the full all-in', 'an engage tool his escapeless kit cannot answer'). Separately the lane is labelled FAV but painted with the hard-matchup colour, rated 8.5/10 difficulty, and report[14] calls it a 'Hard matchup' — four fields, three different answers, on a lane that wins 52.43% over 288 games.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 7s flat and only blanks attacks; Kled's levels 2-3 and his level-6 charge are genuine windows. Teemo owns level 1 and the two-item mushroom map, which is what the packet chart says.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 4 -> Kled (7/10) as paired full+content rows, giving exactly the packet chart. diff -> EVEN with the even tone, diffRating -> 6/10, and the two prose fields that quote the number updated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text credited the Bear Trap with percent-max-HP damage.
audit.why: Kled Q carries no percentHealth flag; it is flat physical plus the yank. The mirror also records the real limit: the yank only fires if the shackle is still on him, so Move Quick (14s) can walk out of it and leave you with the base hit.
audit.corrected: Percent-HP removed from whys[2] and mid; the shackle-can-be-broken rule added to mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The blind was described as shutting off 'your Q autos and W shots' — as if it disabled abilities.
audit.why: Blinding Dart causes attacks to miss. It blanks Violent Tendencies (which is four attacks) and your basic attacks, and it does nothing at all to Bear Trap on a Rope, Jousting or Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! — all three land through a blind. That is the whole reason the lane is playable: you dash and trap while blinded and only hold the autos.
audit.corrected: Stated in early, spikes[1], dosFull[0], report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns, matching the mirror's wording from Teemo's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content early, mid and late fields are written in FIRST PERSON — 'my Q autos', 'I just last-hit', 'the tool his kite has no answer to: charge him' — against the site's second-person voice everywhere else.
audit.why: Three of the longest prose fields on the page read as someone else's diary instead of coaching the reader. Every other matchup in this champion uses 'you'.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten in second person within the length band.

audit.whatIsWrong: Teemo's brush invisibility was never mentioned.
audit.why: Guerrilla Warfare lets him enter and MAINTAIN invisibility while moving inside brush — not just while standing still. That is what makes a facecheck near an objective a free mushroom plus a free trade, and it is the concrete form of the vague 'never facecheck' advice.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely his — his Q blind turns off my Q autos and the W shotgun shots, and he chips Skaarl from outside my trap-yank range while I have no poke to answer, so I just last-hit and protect mount health. But the lane flips at 2 the moment W comes online, and at 3 I have the full kit: bait the blind with a fake step-up, E dash through him (the blind can't stop the dash), then W-Q the sweetspot trap as I yank back in. His poison can't out-damage my remount sustain if I hit that combo.
edits.after: Level 1 is genuinely his — Blinding Dart turns off your attacks, so Violent Tendencies does nothing, and he chips Skaarl from 680 while you have no poke to answer; last-hit and protect mount health. The lane flips at 2 when W lands, and at 3 you have the full kit: bait the 7-second blind with a fake step-up, Jousting through him — the blind never touches the dash — then Bear Trap as you dash back in. His poison cannot out-damage your remount sustain if that combo lands.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 I keep stacking W procs and forcing short trades on his blind cooldown — every time his Q is down I E in and the bear-trap Q does percent-max-HP through his squishy frontline. At 6 my R is the tool his kite has no answer to: charge him into terrain for the knock-back and bonus stacks, or use it to extend a jungle gank since he has zero escape once I reach him. This is the window I have to convert kills, because the clock is on his side.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 you keep forcing short trades on the blind's 7-second cooldown — every time Blinding Dart is down, E in and yank. Keep the trap honest: it only yanks while the shackle is still on him, so if Move Quick carries him out of range you get the base hit and nothing more. At 6 your R is the tool his kite has no answer to: ram him, or extend a jungle gank, since he has no escape once you reach him. Convert now — the clock is his.

edits.before: Late game Teemo becomes a map problem, not a duel I lose head-to-head. His shrooms wall off the lane chokes and objective brush, and his sustained poison-and-kite DPS outscales my frontloaded burst once I physically can't close the gap on him. If I didn't snowball lane in the 2-to-6 window, this tilts back to him hard — so I end before ~25 minutes and never facecheck a bush near Baron or Drake.
edits.after: Late game Teemo is a map problem, not a duel you lose head to head. Noxious Trap walls off the lane chokes and objective brush, and he holds invisibility while MOVING inside a bush, so a facecheck near Baron or Drake is a free mushroom and a free trade. If you didn't snowball the 2-to-6 window this tilts back to him hard — end it before ~25 minutes and let a sweeper lead.
